title: dryopteris wallichiana subsp. coriacea
intro: Dryopteris wallichiana subsp. coriacea, commonly known as the Himalayan shield fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of D. wallichiana subsp. coriacea include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in developing new pharmaceuticals.
